mapper.select: select a.cm_micode,a.cm_codename,b.cm_exename,b.cm_info from CMM0020 a,cmm0036 b where b.cm_syscd=#{id} and b.cm_closedt is null and substr(b.cm_info,58,1)='1' and a.CM_MACODE='JAWON' and a.CM_MICODE=b.cm_rsrccd order by a.cm_micode
select cm_micode,cm_codename from CMM0020 where CM_CLOSEDT is null and CM_MACODE='JAWON' and CM_MICODE=#{id}
